g.text: SDD raises the ﬂoor of AI-assisted engineering. It hits four ceilings at enterprise scale.
The spec is local to one team's view. Cross-team contracts are invisible.
approved by team A tech lead
team A PO never saw the migration
Both PRs merge in the same week
no place in SDD for either architect to look across boundary
The custodians update their slices. No structural link maintains the connection.
New spec in Sprint 8 reads old spec
writes to a table notiﬁcation reads but never writes back
SDD captures the PO's intent. Architecture and design are invisible.
Make specs richer. Senior people drown in review. Engineers wait.
Senior people in review meetings all week
Bottleneck moves from typing to thinking
operating model is not conﬁgured to absorb the shift
